clean_repro.probe: PUT /collections/repro_9416 with vectors={}, then PUT /collections/repro_9416/points with point containing vector data
clean_repro.observed: HTTP 400 with error 'Wrong input: Not existing vector name error: '. Collection created with vectors={} (empty config) correctly rejects points with vector data.

contract_refs: parameter: vectors (object) - Vector params config (single or multi-vector mode)

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: Point insert with vector -> validate vector name against collection config -> vectors={} means no vector config -> VectorNameNotExists error -> HTTP 400
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: VectorNameNotExists 错误是预期的参数校验逻辑，当 collection 的 vectors 配置为空对象 {} 时，拒绝接受任何 vector 数据是正确的行为。

falsification.probe: Verify the error is consistent with collection config - GET collection shows vectors={}
falsification.observed: GET /collections/repro_9416 returns config with vectors: {}, confirming empty vector config. The 400 error correctly rejects invalid input.

cognition_match.note: 未命中 by_design_patterns。但 API 正确拒绝无效输入：empty vectors config + point with vector data = HTTP 400。这是参数校验的正确行为。

verdicts.rationale: LIVE 容器实测证实：创建 collection 时 vectors={}（空配置）后，尝试插入带 vector 数据的点会收到 HTTP 400 错误 'Not existing vector name error'。这是正确的参数校验行为 - 空向量配置意味着该 collection 不支持向量，因此拒绝向量数据是预期行为。原始日志 (raw_qdrant_9416.log) 显示相同的 400 响应。源码显示 VectorNameNotExists 是明确的错误类型，用于参数校验。未发现 contract 违规或物理约束违反。API 优雅地拒绝了无效输入。
